_comment: Skeleton building plan set. Place under millenaire-custom/<submod>/cultures/<culture>/buildings/<category>/<id>.json with the corresponding NBT template co-located as <id>_a_0.nbt in the same folder. Fields marked 'default' may be omitted.
_template_note: Phase 2 ContentFs (spec §6.8): the explicit 'template:' field is FORBIDDEN. The NBT path is derived from the JSON's path and the (variant, level) tuple. Co-locate <id>_<variant>_<level>.nbt next to the JSON.
_category_options: townhalls | houses | special | extra | player | lone (default: houses)
_tags_note: Root-level tags attach to the building itself. Level-level tags are cumulative across levels (iso-legacy).

variants._ground_level_note: Factorise at variant scope when constant across all levels; otherwise set per-level. Default 0.
variants._building_orientation_note: Optional at variant scope (overrides the plan-set default) when variants have different fronts. Resolution: variant -> plan-set -> 1.

levels._nbt_note: NBT lookup is path-relative: the loader resolves my_building_a_0.nbt sibling to this JSON. Do NOT add a 'template:' field — the loader rejects it.
levels._tags_note: Per-level tags are cumulative with previous levels (iso-legacy). Omit when identical to the previous level's cumulative tag set.

_default_weapon: Optional: item id used by military villagers (e.g. 'minecraft:iron_sword'). Legacy tokens (e.g. 'sabre') are mapped at convert time.
_cost_note: infoCost is no longer supported; building cost is computed from the NBT template. Use the BuildingCostExporter in-game command to inspect the material cost of a plan.
_omit_defaults_note: Fields equal to their loader default may be omitted for readability: model=male, base_scale=1.0, is_child=false, category=houses, max_count=1, building_orientation=1, terrain_policy=clear_and_flatten, construction_order=bottom_up, level.priority=100, ground_level=0, tags=[].
